name: Habibur Classic Editor Switch
author: Habibur Rahman

sections.description:
Disable Gutenberg and the WordPress block editor completely. Force the Classic Editor for all post types with a lightweight and fast solution.

Habibur Classic Editor Switch removes block editor support and automatically enables the classic editor without any configuration. It works for posts, pages, and custom post types.

Simple. Fast. No settings required.

This plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by the WordPress or Gutenberg projects.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin from the WordPress admin panel
  3. The Classic Editor will be enabled automatically
sections.faq:
Does this replace the Classic Editor plugin?

Yes. This plugin disables the block editor completely, so you do not need the official Classic Editor plugin.

Does it remove existing content created with Gutenberg?

No. Your existing content remains unchanged. It only switches the editor interface.

Where can I get custom WordPress development help?

Visit https://habibur.net for professional WordPress development services.
